workflow: Production cad-core SCALE and cad-dxf output are parsed with dxf-parser@1.1.2; the twelve-family result is serialized by the production .kdraw writer and independently decoded with envelope byte-length and SHA-256 checks before atomic UNDO.
result: Independent DXF parsing found exact scaled LINE/LWPOLYLINE coordinates, while independent .kdraw decoding found all twelve scaled families with preserved handles and properties. Numeric and point-based Reference parsing, coordinate-factor rejection, Copy handles and locked/proxy rejects matched the golden fixture; a factor-one undo marker advanced one revision, one UNDO consumed only that marker, and the twelve-family SCALE restored in one atomic step.
